name: PiCCANTE
one_line: Firmware turning a Raspberry Pi Pico (or Pico 2/W) plus a CAN transceiver into a 3-channel CAN sniffer/injector with ELM327 emulation and SavvyCAN/SocketCAN compatibility.
why_notable: 93 stars, last commit 2026-01-26. Deliberately cheap alternative to proprietary CAN equipment.

name: PiKVM v4 Plus - Hardware RAT
one_line: KVM-over-IP hardware remote access tool with built-in cellular (3/4/5G) connectivity, marketed for covert drop-in red-team installs.
why_notable: Repurposes KVM-over-IP hardware as a covert, network-independent remote-access implant for red-team engagements.

name: Kronos Electric Pick
one_line: Motorized electric pick gun with adjustable strike amplitude for opening pin-tumbler locks, including higher-security cylinders.
why_notable: The only powered/electronic lock-opening tool in the physical-audit lineup; the rest of that category is purely mechanical picks and bypass tools.

name: PCILeech
one_line: Host-side software for reading and writing a target's memory over PCIe DMA using an FPGA capture card; gateware in the sibling pcileech-fpga repo. Verified board: LambdaConcept Screamer PCIe Squirrel, EUR159 ex-tax.
why_notable: 7915 stars, last commit 2026-07-25. The toolkit that defines the DMA-attack category; the tracked CaptainDMA 75T and Screamer boards exist to run it.

name: T-Deck Plus Kit
one_line: ESP32 handheld with keyboard, LoRa radio, GPS module, touchscreen, and 2000mAh battery, running Meshtastic or custom firmware.
why_notable: A LilyGo LoRa/GPS handheld distinct from the LilyGo devices already tracked (T-Dongle, T-Embed, T-LoRa Pager, T-Watch).

name: Glytch GPS Mod for Pager
one_line: 3D-printed hand-assembled add-on carrying a Quectel LC86 multi-constellation GNSS chipset that clips onto the WiFi Pineapple Pager to geotag its Wi-Fi survey and attack logs.
why_notable: Own chipset and SKU, adds a sensor the base Pager lacks. Seen at $79 and $85.32 at other sellers.

name: Masta-Blasta for Flipper Zero
one_line: High-intensity 12-LED infrared blaster add-on for Flipper Zero that extends IR transmit range/power beyond the built-in emitter.
why_notable: Distinct IR-blaster hardware for Flipper Zero from the Rabbit-Labs 'Slim Shady' already tracked (different maker/board).

name: YubiKey NEO
one_line: USB/NFC hardware authentication token supporting OTP, U2F/FIDO, and PIV/OpenPGP smart-card functions.
why_notable: Its purpose is authentication, not offensive or defensive security testing, though it is commonly stocked to demonstrate/test phishing-resistant auth.

name: MastaBlasta - IR Blaster
one_line: Long-range infrared blaster add-on for Flipper Zero that boosts IR transmit distance/power for remote-control attacks.
why_notable: Higher-power active IR transmitter module for Flipper Zero IR replay attacks, beyond the stock IR emitter's range.

name: IR Blaster
one_line: Seven-LED infrared blaster add-on for Flipper Zero that boosts IR transmit range/power for remote-control attacks.
why_notable: Base-tier active IR transmitter expansion for Flipper Zero IR attacks, a lower-cost sibling to the MastaBlasta/Slim Shady IR blasters.

name: Flipper Add-On: Modbus
one_line: RS485/Modbus Flipper Zero GPIO add-on board for interacting with industrial control protocols.
why_notable: Rare industrial-control-systems (ICS/Modbus) testing add-on for the Flipper Zero platform.

name: EvilAppleJuice ESP32
one_line: firmware only, needs a generic ESP32 - spams BLE Continuity proximity-pairing adverts to trigger repeated iPhone pairing pop-ups.
why_notable: 2254 stars, last commit 2026-06-06. Presented at COSCUP 2025.

name: ChimeraBLE
one_line: firmware only, needs a generic ESP32 (also XIAO ESP32-C5 or Cardputer ADV) - full BLE GATT enumeration, HID report decoding, device cloning/emulation and BLE MITM proxying.
why_notable: 222 stars, last commit 2026-07-07. Host+peripheral+MITM in one tool, unlike the spam/jam-focused BLE projects.

name: Bluetooth Ducky
one_line: firmware only, needs a generic ESP32 - emulates a Bluetooth keyboard that auto-pairs and injects Ducky Script-style payloads, no physical USB access needed.

name: BLE CTF
one_line: firmware only, needs a generic ESP32/S3/C6 - deliberately vulnerable BLE GATT server used as a hands-on CTF for learning BLE enumeration and exploitation.
why_notable: 776 stars, last commit 2026-08-07. De facto standard hands-on BLE training target.

name: OsmocomBB
one_line: Open baseband firmware for Calypso-chipset phones (used Motorola C118/C123/C139, ~$15 secondhand), turning one into a full open GSM stack for air-interface research.
why_notable: 331 stars, last commit 2026-06-17. Long-standing reference tool in GSM security research.
